strings: It seems m_c constantly shakes. After being looked over by r_c, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} diagnosed with wobbly cat syndrome.

After being unable to stand without wobbling, it appears m_c will wobble {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} entire life. Despite this, family is reassured that m_c will live a long and healthy life- just one a bit more wobbly than others.
